ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted CTF training and automated write-up generation pipeline that documents flag captures, commands run, and proof-of-concept exploits in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: Stage 2.2 Final Evaluation requirement for qualified teams to thoroughly document, reproduce, and demonstrate their techniques post-competition.
ideas.title: FlagForge CTF Automation & Automated Write-up Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the Grand Finale's strict evaluation requirement where the top 10 teams must submit comprehensive write-ups and technical proof-of-work, saving exhausted finalists hours of manual documentation.

ideas.pitch: A localized OSINT intelligence tool that ingests disparate artifact feeds, metadata dumps, and public records to automatically map digital footprints for cyber forensic investigations.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview Seize da Flaq challenge domain covering OSINT, digital forensics, and uncovering hidden vulnerabilities from realistic evidence.
ideas.title: OSINT-Trace Multi-Source Credential and Footprint Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages hard engineering to parse complex, messy intelligence data faster than manual shell scripts, matching the high technical rigor expected in a national-level CTF.

ideas.pitch: A specialized static analysis and verification tool built to catch subtle cryptographic implementation flaws, padding oracles, and weak entropy generation in challenge binaries.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview Seize da Flaq challenge domain focusing on cryptography, reverse engineering, and finding flaws in security challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoAudit Zero-Knowledge Cryptographic Vulnerability Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles deeply technical security domains (cryptography and reverse engineering) rather than building a generic wrapper, appealing directly to the cybersecurity experts judging the event.

ideas.pitch: A localized, zero-knowledge encrypted vault application designed for CTF competitors to securely store, organize, and sync captured flags, exploit payloads, and sensitive notes without risk of credential leakage.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview Seize da Flaq competition requirement for participants to investigate evidence, manage findings, and secure data during intense multi-stage rounds.
ideas.title: ZeroGuard Biometric Secure Evidence Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates exceptional polish, military-grade client-side encryption, and a polished UX that stands out amidst standard unstyled hacker tools.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance packet capture analysis tool optimized for edge deployment that automatically flags suspicious beaconing, lateral movement, and hidden flags within raw PCAP files.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview Seize da Flaq challenge domains involving digital forensics and network traffic analysis under strict competition time constraints.
ideas.title: EdgePcap Real-Time Network Forensics & Anomaly Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides raw utility during a fast-paced live CTF by automating tedious packet-filtering tasks, giving teams a tactical edge in dissecting network-based challenges.
